name: Continuation Compression and Equivalence Law
purpose: Define how distinct continuation histories compress into equivalent observable continuation structures.

candidate_law_statement.informal: Multiple distinct continuation histories may project into observationally equivalent continuation-channel states under bounded reconstruction accessibility.

formal.history_family: ℋ(C_P) := { H_i : H_i admissibly projects into observable channel state C_P }
formal.compression_candidate: Compress(H_i → C_P) occurs when reinforcement loss, topology transition, or admissibility filtering removes discriminating continuation structure.
formal.equivalence_relation_candidate: H_i ~_obs H_j iff Ξ(H_i) and Ξ(H_j) produce observationally equivalent admissible continuation structures.
formal.bounded_accessibility_clause: Observational equivalence depends on bounded accessibility and finite reconstruction reachability.
formal.nonuniversal_equivalence_clause: Equivalence is local, admissibility-conditioned, and projection-dependent rather than globally absolute.
